title: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)
description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.


We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?

##### **Responsibilities**


We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer (all genders) with focus on full stack engineering to actively contribute to the development for our remote access solution and server\-side applications using TypeScript/JavaScript, React and the newest standards of C\#. The position will report to the Team Lead Software Development and provides an excellent opportunity to create impact and add value in an agile, modern environment.

* Design and develop new functionality for our high scaling server and user authentication modules using TypeScript/JavaScript, React and C\#
* Continuously participate in application design to further enhance our systems and code base regarding reliability, maintainability, scalability, and efficiency
* Work independently on solutions for specified requirements and be responsible for complying with time and quality specifications
* Ensure that our software is stable and runs efficiently on many different browsers and systems (more than 2\.5 billion installations)
* Act as an advisor towards product owners (feasibility studies and time estimates for new functionality to be implemented)

##### **Requirements**

* University or college degree in the field of computer science, software engineering, or any other related subject
* 8\+ years of professional experience in software development
* Proven background in working with C\#, the .NET framework and understanding of software engineering principles
* Profound knowledge in JavaScript/TypeScript and React
* Knowledge in C\+\+ is advantageous
* Fluency in English is mandatory

  

TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C\-A\-R\-E and understand that our diverse, values\-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best no matter your gender, civil or family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.


If you require any accommodations or adjustments during the application or hiring process, including interview or onboarding support, please reach out to your Talent Acquisition Partner, who will be happy to support you.

title: Senior Software Engineer- Full Stack
description:
**Company Description**  

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.


Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description** **About the Team**


The engineering organization is a dynamic group of builders, thinkers, and problem\-solvers dedicated to delivering scalable, AI\-powered software products that elevate how organizations work. We value clean architecture, intuitive user experiences, and a culture of continuous improvement. Every engineer here plays a key role in shaping the quality and reliability of our products.

**What you get to do in this role:**

* Design and develop scalable, maintainable, and reusable software components with a strong emphasis on performance and reliability.
* Collaborate with product managers to translate requirements into well\-architected solutions, owning features from design through delivery
* Build intuitive and extensible user experiences using modern UI frameworks, ensuring flexibility for customer\-specific needs.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of new products and features while enhancing existing product capabilities.
* Integrate automated testing into development workflows to ensure consistent quality across releases.
* Participate in design and code reviews ensuring best practices in performance, maintainability, and testability.
* Develop comprehensive test strategies covering functional, regression, integration and performance aspects
* Foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement by sharing best practices in engineering and quality
* Promote a culture of engineering craftsmanship, knowledge\-sharing, and thoughtful quality practices across the team.

  

**Qualifications** **To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging critical thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision\-making, or problem\-solving. This may include using AI\-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI\-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
* 6\+ years of experience in software engineering, with a track record of delivering high\-quality products.
* Proficiency in Python, Java, or similar object\-oriented languages.
* Experience with modern front\-end frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue.
* Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented design, design patterns, and performance optimization
* Familiarity with automated testing frameworks (e.g., JUnit, Selenium, TestNG) and integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines
* Understanding software quality principles including reliability, observability, and production readiness.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex systems and optimize performance across the stack.
* Experience with AI\-powered tools or workflows, including validation of datasets, model predictions, and inference consistency.
* Comfort with development tools such as IDEs, debuggers, profilers, source control, and Unix\-based systems


Why Join Us

* Build and deliver high\-impact software that powers digital experiences for millions of users.
* Collaborate in a culture that values craftsmanship, quality, and innovation.
* Work symbiotically with AI and automation tools that enhance engineering excellence and drive product reliability.
* Be part of a culture that encourages innovation, continuous learning, and shared success.

  

**Additional Information** **Work Personas**


We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third\-party service.

In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

**Export Control Regulations**

title: Full-Stack Engineer (Next.js / TypeScript / Cloudflare)
description:
We're a video production and social media company serving 50\+ clients with 743M\+ views delivered. Our entire team of editors, videographers, and producers runs on a platform we built in\-house, and we need an engineer to own it.

This isn't a greenfield project or a big\-company job. You'll be working directly with the team on a real production app used every day, often as the only engineer on a problem. If you like taking a vague bug report, finding the root cause, and shipping the fix yourself, you'll fit right in.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

* Maintain and extend role\-based dashboards for admins, editors, QC, schedulers, videographers, sales, and clients
* Build and debug our production workflow, from task creation and review through QC, scheduling, and client delivery
* Build new features end\-to\-end, including a content approval flow and a QC portal with timestamp\-linked comments
* Maintain our Electron desktop app for client video review
* Own billing, invoicing, and Stripe contractor payouts
* Keep our Cloudflare infrastructure fast and cost\-efficient
* Fix bugs reported by real users across frontend, API, database, and storage
* Build Slack notifications and other integrations as needed

TECH STACK

Next.js 15 (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind · Cloudflare Workers via OpenNext · Neon Postgres with Drizzle (some Prisma) · Cloudflare R2 · Redis · Electron · Stripe · Slack API

WHAT YOU NEED

* Strong TypeScript/JavaScript with hands\-on React and Next.js (App Router a big plus)
* Solid SQL and Postgres skills, including debugging complex queries
* Experience with an ORM like Drizzle or Prisma
* Comfort with S3\-compatible storage and serverless deployment
* Ability to jump into an established codebase and reason about it quickly
* Strong debugging skills and clear written communication

NICE TO HAVE

* Cloudflare Workers, R2, or OpenNext experience
* Electron or Stripe Connect experience
* Experience with video/media workflows or large file handling
* Prior experience as a solo or early\-stage engineer

title: Full Stack developer (AI &SaaS)
description:

Location: India — 100% Work from Home

Employment Type: Full\-Time, Permanent

Experience: 4\+ years of professional software development experience About the Role

We are looking for a hands\-on Senior Full Stack Developer who can turn business ideas, requirements, and wireframes into secure, fully functional, production\-ready applications. You will work directly with the founder to build SaaS products across business management, CRM, construction, workforce management, and workflow automation. Projects will be developed in phases, with ownership spanning architecture, frontend, backend, databases, integrations, testing, and deployment. AI\-assisted development is central to this role. \-Build applications end to end: Translate requirements and wireframes into technical plans, working features, and production deployments.

\- Integrate APIs and AI: Connect third\-party services, email/SMS platforms, and business software. Build AI\-powered assistants, document extraction, summaries, and automation using LLM APIs.

\- Own quality and reliability: Write automated tests, review AI\-generated code, troubleshoot issues, and improve application performance, security, and maintainability.

\- Frontend: Strong React/Next.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML/CSS, responsive design, and API integration skills.

\- Backend and databases: Node.js, Express.js or a similar framework, PostgreSQL/SQL, and MongoDB. Experience with database design, REST APIs, webhooks, and background processing.

end\-to\-end suite of software solutions helps our customers answer thousands of emergency
  

calls and text messages, and process video, disparate evidence and records. We are also proud
  

to be industry leaders in video security solutions installed in more than 120 countries at
  

thousands of customer sites, including school campuses, transportation systems, healthcare
  

centers, public venues, critical infrastructure, prisons, factories, casinos, airports, financial
  

institutions, government facilities, and retailers.
  

Our products leverage cutting\-edge voice technology, language models, natural language
  

understanding, video analytics, and Machine Learning to enable our customers to focus on what
  

matters while providing faster responses, safer outcomes and greater transparency. Our mission
  

is to provide meaningful value to MSI’s customers by developing domain\-specific applications
  

and services in the areas of Speech \& Audio, Machine Translation, Natural Language
  

Understanding and Computer Vision.
  

Calipsa, which is part of MSI, is aiming at automating CCTV video monitoring. We are building a
  

cloud\-based platform that automatically connects with cameras, processes and analyzes their
  

content and only forward actionable alerts to our customers. We are working with the biggest
  

security companies in the world, actively monitoring over 25 thousand sites worldwide. We are
  

expecting to massively grow the number of cameras and traffic on our platform in the near
  

future.
  

Our cloud\-based platform connects seamlessly with all cameras regardless of their brand or
  

model and processes a wide range of analytics in real\-time. You will be part of a small growing
  

team who will focus on achieving robust and scalable architecture in order to enable millions of
  

alarms to be processed on our platform. You will be developing features that enable customers
  

to get more insight and intelligence from their cameras. Everything that you do will need to scale
  

as it will serve hundreds of thousands of cameras all around the world. Being able to make
  

accurate estimates and deliver them is crucial in order to manage expectations from internal
  

and external stakeholders.
**Job Description**
-------------------

* Responsible for the building frontend and backend
* Designing efficient architecture to respond to customer requirements
* Building highly scalable systems with a lot of traffic
* Solve difficult issues, including performance or concurrency issues, and propose

solutions
* Guide product decisions and the team roadmap with an engineering perspective
**Basic Requirements**
----------------------

**Basic Requirements**

* **Core Tech Stack:** 5\+ years of software engineering experience with advanced proficiency in **TypeScript** and **Node.js** .
* **Frontend Expertise:** Strong hands\-on experience with **Vue.js** (or React).
* **Backend Pipeline Ownership:** Proven track record of developmeing complex, heavy\-load backend pipelines, including message queue systems (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS).
* **API \& Networking:** Strong experience designing and maintaining **OpenAPI** specifications.
* **Teamwork:** Demonstrated strong team player skills with a collaborative approach to engineering.

**Desired Skills**

* **Cloud \& DevOps Infrastructure:** Hands\-on **Kubernetes** experience with **AWS or GCP** , along with extensive experience building and maintaining modern **CI/CD** pipelines.
* **Scalable Systems:** Excitement about building, operating, and architecting resilient, high\-throughput systems that impact a global community of users.
* **Observability \& Performance:** Proactive drive for observability (monitoring, logging, tracing) to diagnose problems and optimize system performance.
* **Distributed Work:** Comfortable working asynchronously in a highly distributed, remote\-first team environment across multiple time zones.

**Travel Requirements**
-----------------------

None

-----------------------

None

-----------------

Experienced

-------------------------


Yes

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Quality Enterprises is looking for an experienced Full Stack Developer to join our technology team and develop web\-based software solutions for US\-based logistics and transportation companies.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in full\-stack web development, backend architecture, databases, REST APIs, and modern frontend technologies. Experience developing TMS, trucking, dispatch, fleet management, or logistics software will be highly preferred.

* Develop, maintain, and enhance web\-based software for US logistics and transportation companies.

* Develop and integrate REST APIs and third\-party APIs.
* Build modules for dispatch, load management, driver management, fleet management, billing, claims, tracking, and reporting.
* Design, develop, and optimize relational databases.
* Integrate logistics APIs such as GPS tracking, mapping, EDI, and transportation platforms.
* Develop secure authentication, authorization, and role\-based access systems.

title: Full Stack Developer Internship
description:
Full Stack Developer – Internship \+ Full\-Time Opportunity

(Note: Required Local Candidates only)

**Company:** KrinosAI – Dental AI Startup

**Website:** https://krinosai.com/

**Internship Duration:** 3 Months

**Internship Type:** Full\-Time, On\-Site

**Internship Stipend:** ₹10,000 – ₹15,000 per month

**Future Opportunity:** Full\-Time Employment based on performance, technical capability, and successful completion of the internship

**Full\-Time Salary:** To be determined based on demonstrated skill set, performance during the internship, technical ownership, and role responsibilities

About KrinosAI

KrinosAI is a healthcare technology company developing AI\-powered solutions for dentistry, including dental imaging, computer vision, patient engagement, workflow automation, AI voice agents, clinical software, and intelligent healthcare applications.

Our engineering team works across full\-stack development, artificial intelligence, cloud infrastructure, computer vision, automation, healthcare integrations, and advanced visualization.

We are looking for developers who want to work on real products rather than only academic or isolated development assignments.

About the Opportunity

We are looking for a **Full Stack Developer Intern** for an intensive **3\-month full\-time, on\-site internship**.

The internship is designed as an evaluation and development period for candidates who may subsequently join KrinosAI as **Full\-Time Full Stack Developers**.

During the three months, candidates will work directly on live KrinosAI products and will be evaluated on:

· Technical capability

· Problem\-solving ability

· Speed of learning

· Code quality

· Ability to independently complete tasks

· Frontend and backend development skills

· Debugging capability

· System\-design understanding

· API integration skills

· Cloud and deployment knowledge

· Ownership and reliability

· Ability to work within an engineering team

Candidates demonstrating strong technical ability and ownership may receive a **full\-time employment offer after completion of the internship**.

The compensation for the subsequent full\-time position will be determined according to the candidate's demonstrated skills, performance, technical maturity, and responsibilities they can independently handle.

Key Responsibilities1\. Frontend Development

Develop responsive, scalable, and production\-ready applications using:

· React.js

· Next.js

· JavaScript

· TypeScript

· HTML

· CSS

· Modern UI libraries and component frameworks

You will be expected to:

· Convert UI/UX designs into working applications

· Develop reusable frontend components

· Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs

· Handle application state and authentication

· Develop responsive interfaces for desktop, tablet, and mobile

· Optimize page loading and frontend performance

· Debug browser and frontend application issues

2\. Backend Development

Develop and maintain backend systems using technologies such as:

· Node.js

· Express.js

· Python

· FastAPI

· Flask

· Django

Responsibilities may include:

· Developing REST APIs

· Building application business logic

· Managing authentication and authorization

· Implementing background processes

· Managing application workflows

· Developing secure server\-side functionality

· Building integrations with third\-party services

· Writing scalable and maintainable backend architecture

3\. Database Development

Work with relational and NoSQL databases including:

· PostgreSQL

· MongoDB

· DynamoDB

· MySQL

· AWS RDS

Responsibilities include:

· Database schema design

· Data modelling

· Writing efficient queries

· Database migrations

· Data validation

· Performance optimization

· Designing relationships between different application entities

4\. API Development \& Integration

Design and integrate APIs between different systems.

You may work on:

· REST APIs

· Webhooks

· WebSockets

· Third\-party APIs

· AI service APIs

· Healthcare software integrations

· Authentication APIs

· Communication APIs

· Internal microservices

Candidates should understand:

· Request/response architecture

· API authentication

· Error handling

· API documentation

· Testing APIs

· JSON data structures

· Webhooks and asynchronous workflows

5\. AI \& Machine Learning Integration

The role does not require candidates to be dedicated ML engineers, but developers should be comfortable integrating AI systems into applications.

You may work with:

· Computer vision models

· AI inference APIs

· LLM APIs

· Speech\-to\-text systems

· Voice AI

· Image\-processing pipelines

· Python ML services

· AI\-generated structured data

Responsibilities may include connecting AI/ML models developed by our AI team with production applications.

6\. 3D \& Medical Visualization

Depending on the project, candidates may work on interactive visualization using:

· Three.js

· WebGL

· React Three Fiber

· 3D model rendering

· Medical\-image visualization

· Interactive dental models

· Spatial interfaces

Experience with Three.js is an advantage but is not mandatory for candidates with otherwise strong development fundamentals.

Cloud \& Deployment

Candidates will receive exposure to production cloud infrastructure and deployment.

Technologies may include:

AWS

· EC2

· ECS

· Fargate

· S3

· RDS

· DynamoDB

· Cognito

· CloudFront

· Route 53

· API Gateway

· Lambda

· ECR

· CloudWatch

· Secrets Manager

· AWS IAM

· SageMaker

Deployment \& DevOps

· Docker

· GitHub

· GitHub Actions

· CI/CD pipelines

· Vercel

· Nginx

· Environment configuration

· Production monitoring

· Development/staging/production environments

Candidates are not expected to know every technology before joining but should be willing to learn quickly.

Authentication \& Security

Candidates may work with:

· JWT

· OAuth

· Role\-based access control

· User authentication

· Session management

· API authorization

· Secure environment variables

· Encryption concepts

· Secure cloud architecture

As KrinosAI operates in healthcare technology, developers will also gain exposure to building applications where **security, privacy, reliability, and patient\-data protection** are important engineering considerations.

Git \& Engineering Workflow

Candidates should be comfortable with:

· Git

· GitHub

· Branching

· Pull requests

· Code reviews

· Merge conflict resolution

· Issue tracking

· Collaborative development

Developers will be expected to maintain organized repositories and follow structured engineering practices.

Required Skills

Candidates should have a good understanding of:

· JavaScript

· React.js

· HTML/CSS

· Basic frontend development

· Node.js or Python backend development

· APIs

· Databases

· Git/GitHub

Candidates should have completed at least some practical projects independently or as part of academic/personal development.

We value **demonstrable development ability more than certificates**.

Preferred Skills

Experience with any of the following will be considered an advantage:

· Next.js

· TypeScript

· Node.js

· Express.js

· FastAPI

· Django

· Flask

· PostgreSQL

· MongoDB

· AWS

· Docker

· REST APIs

· WebSockets

· Three.js

· AI/LLM APIs

· Computer vision

· Healthcare applications

· SaaS development

Candidates are **not required to know all of these technologies**.

Strong fundamentals and the ability to learn new technologies quickly are more important.

What We Look For

We are particularly interested in candidates who:

· Enjoy building products from scratch

· Can learn technologies independently

· Are comfortable solving unfamiliar technical problems

· Take ownership of assigned work

· Can debug problems systematically

· Ask technical questions when necessary

· Can understand an existing codebase

· Are comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment

· Are interested in AI and healthcare technology

· Want to build a long\-term career in software engineering

Performance Evaluation

At the end of the internship, candidates will be evaluated primarily on:

**Technical Skills**

· Frontend development

· Backend development

· Database understanding

· API development

· Debugging ability

· Code quality

**Execution**

· Task completion

· Development speed

· Reliability

**Engineering Maturity**

· Maintainability of code

· Testing practices

· Security awareness

· Documentation

**Professional Performance**

· Ownership

· Communication

· Teamwork

· Consistency

· Ability to accept and implement feedback

Full\-Time Employment Opportunity

Candidates successfully completing the internship may be offered a position as:

Full Stack Developer

Depending upon the candidate's strongest skills and company requirements, the eventual role may evolve toward:

· Full Stack Developer

· Frontend Developer

· Backend Developer

· Full Stack \+ AI Integration Developer

· Cloud/Backend Developer

· Product Engineer

· 3D/Web Visualization Developer

The final role will be determined according to the candidate's demonstrated strengths.

Full\-Time Compensation

There is **no predetermined uniform salary for every intern converting to full\-time employment**.

The full\-time compensation package will be decided based on:

· Technical skill level demonstrated during the internship

· Ability to independently develop production features

· Frontend/backend competency

· Cloud and deployment knowledge

· Problem\-solving ability

· Code quality

· Speed and reliability

· Ownership of projects

· Overall contribution during the internship

Exceptional candidates who demonstrate strong technical ownership may be offered a higher compensation package and greater engineering responsibility.

Internship Stipend₹10,000 – ₹15,000 per month

The exact internship stipend within this range will be determined based on:

· Current technical capability

· Previous projects

· Development experience

· Interview performance

· Knowledge of the technologies relevant to the role

Who Can Apply

We welcome applications from:

· Final\-year B.Tech/B.E./BCA/MCA/M.Tech students

· Computer Science / IT graduates

· Recent graduates

· Self\-taught developers with strong portfolios

· Candidates with relevant full\-stack development projects

Academic degree alone will not determine selection.

Candidates should be able to demonstrate their technical capability through projects, GitHub repositories, assignments, or technical discussions.

Selection Process

The recruitment process may include:

1\. Application screening

2\. Portfolio/GitHub/project review

3\. Technical discussion

4\. Practical coding or development assignment

The emphasis will be on **practical development capability rather than theoretical knowledge alone**.

What We Offer

· Work on production applications rather than dummy internship projects

· Exposure to AI and computer\-vision integrations

· Direct collaboration with engineering and product teams

Important

This is a **full\-time, on\-site internship**.

Candidates looking exclusively for a remote internship or a short\-term academic internship should not apply.

We are particularly looking for candidates interested in joining KrinosAI beyond the internship and developing into long\-term members of the engineering team.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Director of Engineering - Studio Team
description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.


Living our values everyday results in our team\-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.


The Five9 Studio engineering team drive the realization of practical AI solutions for the contact centre environment. Our existing Studio product stack is built on Laravel Framework\-PHP, Python and Vue.js technology deployed in private and public clouds. We leverage the latest cloud AI services such as OpenAI, Google Speech and Dialogflow, Deepgram, IBM Watson and Wellsaid and integrate into Five9 wider well\-developed microservices platform.



Our vision for practical AI involves equipping contact centre agents, supervisors and managers with user interfaces that guide and summarize their work, identify points of coaching and support, and fully automate routine interactions. This latter part is the focus of the Studio Engineering team, enabling our customers to create and tune implementation of AI agents into their voice and digital channels for their end\-customer self\-service and steering to best agent.


**Role purpose**



The purpose of this role is to build and lead a team of developers and quality assurance that will design, develop, and maintain software solutions and drive the implementation of best practices in continuous integration, continuous delivery and service ownership within a fast\-paced environment.



This role requires a hands\-on approach and while it spends some time undertaking development, it will ultimately contribute to delivering exceptional customer experience.


**How you contribute**


* Lead and mentor a team of software development engineers responsible for designing, implementing, monitoring and tooling our cloud services.
* Identify and hire suitable employees in partnership with the Talent Acquisition team.
* Provide coaching, feedback, and development opportunities to enhance skills, motivation, and performance of team members.
* Oversee the design, development, and implementation of features and functionality aligning with the feature goals. Ensure adherence to best practices, standards, and security protocols.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and quality assurance professionals, to ensure that everyone is aligned around goals and progress.
* Drive the adoption of modern technologies, tools and practices to streamline development workflows, improve efficiency, and enhance the quality and reliability of our software.
* Apply strong understanding of various programming languages, frameworks, and development methodologies, to enable informed decisions and solve complex technical challenges.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues by applying problem\-solving skills to identify the root causes and implement effective solutions.
* Manage relationships with cloud service providers, tool vendors, and other external partners.
* Drive a culture of collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning within the team and across the organization.
* Apply a can do "attitude" and finds solutions for complex distributed problems.
* Take part in roadmap planning and manage execution process
* Collaborate with leadership on long\-term vision, and strategy


**Skills, competencies and qualifications**


* 8\+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
* A portfolio of past projects showcasing backend and full stack development skills, preferably on a cloud based platforms (GCP, AWS or Azure).
* Proficiency and strong experience in one or more backend languages / technologies as PHP, Python, Java, and familiarity with frontend Javascript frameworks such as REACT and or Vue.JS
* In\-depth understanding of microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, and distributed systems. Telephony and SIP desirable.
* Experience with QA automation, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps best practices, preferably hands\-on experience developing services in a containerization environment
* Awareness of security best practices and the ability to implement security measures to protect applications and data.
* Demonstrates critical thinking with sound analytical, debugging skills
* Strong commitment to delivering high\-quality code and solutions on time and within scope.
* Strong communicator who can express thoughts and ideas clearly and effectively.
* Demonstrated experience building strong cross functional team relationships.
* Demonstrated ability to hire and onboard developers at rapid rate.
* Experience in developing and/or assessing processes and procedures and drive meaningful improvements.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively with multiple teams across various time zones.
* Prior experience managing remote and distributed staff.
* Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in relevant discipline.


**Other requirements**


* This position requires the ability to be On Call.


**Key relationships**



Manages a team of up to 15 – 25 Engineers and Managers



Key stakeholders include:


* Product Managers
* Product Architects
* Quality Assurance Team
* Cloud Platform team


Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better we are. Five9 is an equal opportunity employer.



View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https://www.five9\.com/pt\-pt/legal.  

  



Note: Five9 will never request that an applicant send money as a prerequisite for commencing employment with Five9\.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Java Fullstack
description:
Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.


Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.

**Staff Software Engineer**
===========================

**Role Overview**  

We are looking for 12\+ years of strong Full Stack Engineers with expertise in backend development using Java \& Spring Boot, and frontend development using ReactJS or React Native, with TypeScript skills. You will work across the full technology stack to design, build, and deliver high\-quality features and scalable software solutions.

 **Key Responsibilities**  

 Develop and maintain backend services using Java, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture  

 Build responsive, high\-quality UI using ReactJS or React Native with TypeScript  

 Collaborate with product, design, and cross\-functional engineering teams to deliver end\-to\-end features  

 Write clean, maintainable, and robust code following best practices  

 Integrate RESTful APIs and manage data flows across services  

 Contribute to architectural decisions and participate in code reviews  

 Diagnose and resolve production issues with strong ownership

**Required Skills**  

**Backend**  

 Strong knowledge of Java (8/11/17\)  

 Hands\-on experience with Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices  

 Familiarity with Hibernate/JPA  

 Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB

**Frontend**  

 Strong experience with ReactJS or React Native  

 Mandatory proficiency in TypeScript  

 Knowledge of hooks, functional components, and state management (Redux/MobX)  

 Good understanding of HTML5, CSS3, and responsive UI

**General / Additional Skills**  

 Good understanding of Git, CI/CD, and DevOps practices  

 Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure)  

 Strong debugging, analytical, and problem\-solving abilities

**Preferred Qualifications**  

 Experience with Docker, Kubernetes  

 Knowledge of event\-driven systems or Kafka  

 Exposure to unit testing and UI testing tools (JUnit, Jest, Cypress, etc.)  

 Experience in fintech or large\-scale distributed systems is a plus

**Education**  

 BE/B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or any engineering stream (mandatory)

**Why Join Candescent?**  

 Opportunity to work on modern tech and high\-impact products  

 Collaborative, learning\-friendly, and transparent work culture  

 Competitive compensation and growth opportunities

**Statement to Third Party Agencies**

Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.
